items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He used to play with Nat Toll. You know the bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah, he's crazy. I was running crazy. He's all right, but when he get out there, he gets to that stuff. And he just went and I could pick him up again. They said he wasn't going to let him out no more. He came to be a preacher now. Yeah, he's very good. He's very something like this. I'm trying to. He's a young fella. Yeah, Joe about 26 years old now. How old, what's his name? What's his real name? That's all I know, Joe. I know, but I don't forget. He's a young fella. I don't know. Joe about 26 years old now.…
